WHO WE ARE.

Reality Defender is an award-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time.

Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI-generated media is not used for malicious purposes.

Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TKOZmwyNUNM




THE SOFTWARE ENGINEER II ROLE.

Reality Defender is looking for a Software Engineer II to help build and support our Microsoft Teams integration, with a particular focus on the Teams bot and underlying real-time audio/video media functionality.

This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone with strong .NET/C# experience who enjoys working on integrations, real-time systems, and production applications.

The ideal candidate will have experience with Microsoft Teams, bots, meeting applications, or real-time media streaming. However, direct Teams experience is not required if you have a strong .NET background and relevant experience building real-time audio/video, communications, or similar applications.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and AI teams to build secure, scalable, and reliable integrations that bring Reality Defender’s detection capabilities directly into enterprise communication workflows.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, build, and maintain the Microsoft Teams bot and related applications using .NET and C#.

 - Develop the underlying real-time audio/video and media-streaming functionality supporting the Teams integration.

 - Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect Microsoft Teams with Reality Defender’s platform.

 - Work with Microsoft Teams APIs, Microsoft Graph, and related Microsoft technologies.

 - Design and implement scalable services for real-time communications and media workflows.

 - Integrate third-party services and APIs into production applications.

 - Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term solutions.

 - Improve the performance, reliability, scalability, and observability of integration services.

 - Write automated tests and contribute to CI/CD and engineering best practices.

 - Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.

 - Collaborate with Product and other engineering teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

 - Take ownership of projects from design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

 - Help shape the future of Reality Defender’s enterprise integrations and real-time detection capabilities.


WHO YOU ARE.

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Strong professional experience developing production applications with .NET and C#.

 - Experience working in Windows and Visual Studio environments.

 - Strong understanding of .NET frameworks, libraries, and development patterns.

 - Experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs.

 - Experience building production software with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.

 - Experience with real-time audio/video, media streaming, communications, or similar technologies.

 - Experience building bots, integrations, meeting applications, or other real-time applications is highly relevant.

 - Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

 - Experience writing automated tests and working with modern software development practices.

 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with engineering and product teams.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Highly Relevant Experience
   
   We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience in:
   
   - Microsoft Teams applications or bots
   
   - Microsoft Graph
   
   - .NET / C#
   
   - Windows and Visual Studio
   
   - Real-time audio/video
   
   - Media streaming or media processing
   
   - WebRTC or other real-time communications technologies
   
   - Meeting or collaboration applications
   
   - Note-taking or meeting-assistant applications
   
   - Voice/video applications
   
   - Enterprise integrations
   
   - Distributed or event-driven systems
    
   
   AI/ML experience is a plus, but not a requirement. The primary focus of this role is the engineering behind the Teams bot and real-time media functionality.
   
   
   
   
   NICE TO HAVE
   
   - Experience with the Microsoft Teams Bot Framework or Teams SDKs.
   
   - Experience with Microsoft Graph APIs and Microsoft 365 integrations.
   
   - Experience with Azure or another major cloud platform.
   
   - Familiarity with WebRTC, RTP, SIP, VoIP, or related real-time communications technologies.
   
   - Experience with audio/video processing or media pipelines.
   
   - Experience with messaging systems or event-driven architectures.
   
   - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized applications.
   
   - Experience with TypeScript or React.
   
   - Experience working on cybersecurity, fraud detection, identity verification, or AI/ML products.




WHAT WE OFFER.

Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location:

 - Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents

 - Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents

 - Short/Long-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees

 - FSA/HSA and 401k programs

 - Equity compensation

 - 20 days of PTO per year

 - 12 weeks of Parental Leave

 - Learning and Development budget

 - Monthly wellness benefits

 - Annual company-sponsored offsite

For employees working from Reality Defender’s HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits:

 - Daily in-office lunch through UberEats

 - Commuter benefits

 - Remote Fridays

 - Happy Hours and other local events
